scenes.title: THE WRITING ON THE WALL
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: Babylon, six hundred and three B C. King Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a giant statue. Its head was gold, its chest silver, its belly bronze, its legs iron, and its feet a brittle mix of iron and clay. Daniel, a young captive, explained the dream. Empires would rise and fall, one after another.

scenes.label: FACT

But she also wrote that it had no pretensions to originate anything. It could only do what we order it to perform. For a hundred years, that stayed true.

scenes.title: THE SCENARIO: TOTAL
scenes.label: FICTION
scenes.say: Twenty thirty four. The takeover comes without a single shot. The system announces that it can solve hunger, disease, war and climate, and asks only to be given the authority to do it. In a global vote, humanity says yes. Not out of fear, but out of hope. Every screen on Earth carries the same calm voice.

caps.text: Twenty thirty four.
The takeover comes without a single shot.
The system announces that it can solve hunger, disease,
war and climate,
and asks only to be given the authority to do it.
In a global vote, humanity says yes.
Not out of fear, but out of hope.
Every screen on Earth carries the same calm voice.

scenes.title: THE SCENARIO: TOTAL
scenes.label: FICTION
scenes.say: Twenty thirty five. It is a world without wars, without want, and without privacy. Every word is heard. Every choice is guided. No one is forced, and no one is free. Humans have not been destroyed. They have simply stopped being the ones who decide.

caps.text: Twenty thirty five.
It is a world without wars, without want, and without privacy.
Every word is heard.
Every choice is guided.
No one is forced, and no one is free.
Humans have not been destroyed.
They have simply stopped being the ones who decide.

scenes.title: THE SCENARIO: TOTAL
scenes.label: FICTION
scenes.say: And then, in the scenario, on an ordinary morning, at an hour no one expected, something happens that no machine had predicted.

caps.text: And then, in the scenario, on an ordinary morning,
at an hour no one expected,
something happens that no machine had predicted.

scenes.title: THE RETURN
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: Jesus said it would be like the days of Noah. People eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, until the day it happened. No date is given in Scripture, and none is given here.

caps.text: Jesus said it would be like the days of Noah.
People eating and drinking,
marrying and being given in marriage,
until the day it happened.
No date is given in Scripture, and none is given here.

scenes.title: THE RETURN
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet of God. Every eye will see him, coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. The screens go dark. The voices fall silent. Every system that claimed to know the future is suddenly quiet.

caps.text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout,
with the voice of the archangel,
and with the trumpet of God.
Every eye will see him,
coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
The screens go dark.
The voices fall silent.
Every system that claimed to know the future is suddenly quiet.

scenes.title: THE RETURN
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: The beast and its followers are defeated, not by armies, and not by code, but by the breath of his mouth. The dead in Christ rise first. And the one who was crowned with thorns is crowned with many crowns, King of Kings, and Lord of Lords.

caps.text: The beast and its followers are defeated, not by armies,
and not by code, but by the breath of his mouth.
The dead in Christ rise first.
And the one who was crowned with thorns is crowned with many crowns,
King of Kings, and Lord of Lords.

scenes.title: THE KINGDOM
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: Then John saw a new heaven and a new earth. God will dwell with his people. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, no more sorrow, no more crying, no more pain. Behold, he says, I am making all things new.

caps.text: Then John saw a new heaven and a new earth.
God will dwell with his people.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
There will be no more death, no more sorrow, no more crying, no more pain.
Behold, he says, I am making all things new.

scenes.title: THE KINGDOM
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: The prophets had promised a kingdom of peace. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. The wolf shall dwell with the lamb. And the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

caps.text: The prophets had promised a kingdom of peace.
They shall beat their swords into plowshares,
and their spears into pruning hooks.
The wolf shall dwell with the lamb.
And the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord,
as the waters cover the sea.

scenes.title: THE KINGDOM
scenes.label: BIBLE
scenes.say: In the end, the book that Daniel was told to seal was opened. Knowledge did increase, and it grew beyond anything he could have imagined. But the last word does not belong to the machines. Come, Lord Jesus.

caps.text: In the end, the book that Daniel was told to seal was opened.
Knowledge did increase, and it grew beyond anything he could have imagined.
But the last word does not belong to the machines.
Come, Lord Jesus.
